name: thegram-cloud
description: Thegram memory for cloud agents such as ChatGPT dots: the agent loads and records project memory on its own and saves what it reads from Slack, Gmail and other connectors, through https://vault.thegram.one/mcp signed in with your Thegram account. No Mac or desktop app needs to run.

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory in your Thegram vaults and Google Drive
interface.longDescription: Thegram is your long-term memory. The agent reads it before answering, records decisions, tasks and events as they happen, and saves what it gathers from Slack, Gmail, Calendar and other connectors into .gram documents in Thegram Cloud or your Google Drive.
defaultPrompt: What changed in my project memory this week?
Summarize today's Slack and Gmail and keep what matters.
